$comment: What this build changed this round, shown to the judge by src/round-notes.ts. Overwrite every round: your round number and 4-5 one-liners. npm run check validates the shape.
notes: After the storm there is a fourth zone: the Still Hollow, a cave of still water instead of more forest
A kindled press on a dim stone ring plants a lantern and spends the glow - that is where the reach goes now
Planted lights stay, slow nearby shadows, and are where a death returns you; five open the heart
Two walked motes kindle the next plant - they do not open the way out
Walk into the heart and the ending is a dawn made of the lanterns you left, not a fade to black
